name: Painterly Light by D'Ann Boal
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
The Painterly Light Image recipe draws inspiration from the Dutch Master Painters of the 17th Century, who revolutionized art with techniques like chiaroscuro. Rembrandt, in particular, perfected the use of light and shadow to create beautiful and emotional works of art. 
This image recipe is designed for photographs taken in the style of these masters by accentuating the play of light and shadow. It deepens blues and shadows to intensify the contrast between light and dark, echoing the dramatic effects seen in classic paintings. It also enhances golden tones and highlights, providing warmth in the lighter areas of the frame. This image recipe will enhance images taken with directional light giving your photograph additional depth, saturation and contrast.
